title: Composition of normalized ordinary finite scalar endpoints
statement: Let T be a scheme, A to B to C unital maps of commutative rings, N any natural number annihilating them, and a,b,e normalized endpoint records [def-sp-p1-kummer-scalar-endpoints] for A to B, A to C, B to C. Under the canonical scalar-extension composition comparison alpha, extension of a.unitIso followed by e.unitIso equals alpha at the A unit followed by b.unitIso. The corresponding equation holds for the shiftedLineIso maps with shift two. No Chern arrow, invertibility or finiteness assumption is needed once the endpoint records exist.

proof.text: Ordinary constant insertions compose because both send a to psi(phi(a)); the constants adjunction detects this equality. Tate insertions compose by the same equality on a tensor z; tensor and sheafification universal properties detect it.

Compatibility of exact restriction with the single functor turns these ordinary equations into equations of derived units. Transposing with the three adjunctions gives the unit and unshifted-line equations for their canonical left-adjoint composition comparison.

Exact derived restrictions and their composition comparison commute with shifts. Taking mates gives compatibility of the left-adjoint composition comparison with the adjunction shift isomorphisms. Shift the line equation by two and apply this compatibility. This is an equation of derived morphisms, not just cohomology maps.

lean.statement:
theorem p1KummerScalarEndpointComposition
    {A B C : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    {φ : A →+* B} {ψ : B →+* C} {T : Scheme.{u}} {N : ℕ}
    {hA : (N : A) = 0} {hB : (N : B) = 0} {hC : (N : C) = 0}
    (a : P1KummerScalarEndpoints φ N hA hB T)
    (b : P1KummerScalarEndpoints (ψ.comp φ) N hA hC T)
    (e : P1KummerScalarEndpoints ψ N hB hC T) :
    (scalarExtension ψ T).map a.unitIso.hom ≫ e.unitIso.hom =
        (ProEtale.pbcFixedScalarExtensionComp T.smallEtaleTopology
          φ ψ (ψ.comp φ) rfl).hom.app (ordinaryFiniteUnit A T) ≫ b.unitIso.hom ∧
      (scalarExtension ψ T).map a.shiftedLineIso.hom ≫ e.shiftedLineIso.hom =
        (ProEtale.pbcFixedScalarExtensionComp T.smallEtaleTopology
          φ ψ (ψ.comp φ) rfl).hom.app
            ((ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA T)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧) ≫ b.shiftedLineIso.hom
